name: oficina
description: Creates complete AI agents for any domain: /oficina:create-agent (alias /oficina:crear-agente) interviews you, researches the domain in depth and generates a universal agent folder (identity + managed memory + skills, works in Codex and Claude Code) under the La Oficina Protocol. Distributes ready-made private agents too: /oficina:package-agent ships an agent as a verified, optionally password-protected file, and /oficina:install-agent installs one from a download code or a received file. Includes /oficina:recursive-research. Works in the user's language.
